name: Nandrolone joint-support cruise

lead: A 'cruise' in steroid-user slang is a lower-intensity period between higher-dose phases. The 'deca cruise' is a version where nandrolone, an injectable anabolic steroid also called Deca, is included in the cruise, with users citing joint comfort as a reason [1][2].

The claimed chain is that more comfortable joints let people keep training hard, which supports muscle and a fuller physique. The medical references on nandrolone describe uses for anemia, cachexia and osteoporosis and do not list joint treatment, so the joint claim comes from user reports [3].

paras: On T Nation, users describe adding small amounts of nandrolone, in the form of Deca or NPP, to a cruise that also contains testosterone and sometimes Masteron, and some mention taking hCG [1][4]. Details of amounts are individual and are not covered here.

Forum members themselves report side effects, including a sexual-function problem nicknamed 'deca dick', which some treat by switching compounds [5]. Another poster notes that nandrolone metabolites persist for a long period [6]. Medical references note androgenic effects, possible cardiovascular and fertility effects at high doses, and that non-medical use is illegal in many countries [3].

chain: Nandrolone used at low levels in a cruise
angle.text: Users describe nandrolone as helping their joints feel better so they can keep training between higher-intensity phases, which supports the physique they are building. The joint effect is reported by users rather than listed in medical references.

lead: The nandrolone joint-support cruise is a practice described by anabolic steroid users in lifting forums such as T Nation. In bodybuilding slang a 'cruise' is a period of lower-intensity use between 'blasts' of higher intensity, and nandrolone, sold as Deca-Durabolin or in the phenylpropionate form NPP, is sometimes included in it [1][2].

The stated appeal is joint comfort. Users say nandrolone leaves joints feeling better, so they can train consistently, and consistent training supports muscle retention and a fuller physique. Forum posters describe cruise blends of a testosterone ester, nandrolone and Masteron as a way to maintain progress while keeping joints comfortable [2].

Nandrolone is an androgen receptor agonist with a high anabolic-to-androgenic ratio, first synthesized in 1950 and introduced medically in 1959 and 1962 [3]. Its medical uses include anemia, cachexia and osteoporosis, and the references do not list joint conditions as an indication [3].
infobox: Controlled in many countries, e.g. Schedule III (US)

paras: Forum threads describe nandrolone being added to a cruise built around testosterone, sometimes with Masteron. One participant describes adding NPP to a cruise because of a sexual-sensitivity issue with Masteron, and others note taking hCG on both cycle and cruise [2][4]. Another poster says nandrolone and post-cycle therapy do not belong in the same plan because nandrolone metabolites linger for a long period, and that it is an agent used mostly by blast-and-cruise users [1].

sections.h: Reported side effects in the community
paras: Some users describe 'deca dick', a sexual-function side effect, and one says he stopped as soon as it began and later used Masteron, which he said helped [5]. Other forum members say they would not use nandrolone or trenbolone because of risk against reward [6].

Nandrolone esters have been used for anemia, cachexia, osteoporosis and breast cancer, and are rarely used now [3]. Reported adverse effects include masculinization, with virilization in about half of women in osteoporosis studies, and high doses may cause cardiovascular toxicity, hypogonadism and infertility [3]. It has been banned in Olympic sport since 1974, and non-medical use is generally illegal [3].
No studies found on a nandrolone joint-support cruise. Medical sources list other uses of nandrolone and do not describe joint-comfort trials [3].

lore.intro: On T Nation, nandrolone appears in cruise discussions alongside testosterone and Masteron [2][4].

claims.claim: Nandrolone keeps joints comfortable during a cruise.
Nandrolone has a heavier side-effect load than other compounds.
